literal: Even seed sowing is it necessary indeed, of him who, having hosted guests, eats the remnant, the field?
translation: Is it even necessary to sow seed in the field of one who eats only the remnants after hosting guests?
modern: விருந்தினரை உபசரித்துவிட்டு எஞ்சிய உணவை உண்பவனுடைய நிலத்தில், விதை விதைக்கவும் வேண்டுமோ?
explanation: This couplet uses a beautiful poetic hyperbole to praise the virtue of hospitality. It asks rhetorically if a farmer even needs to sow seeds in his field if he is someone who eats only the leftovers (மிச்சில்) after feeding his guests (விருந்து ஓம்பி). The word 'மிசைவான்' means 'he who eats', and 'புலம்' refers to his agricultural field. The poet suggests that nature itself will bless such a selfless host with effortless abundance, making the physical act of sowing seed redundant.
